Callout.Name: Unexploded Charge - Quarry
Callout.Message: Unexploded charge found at a quarry.
Callout.Advisory: Shot area isolated, contractors stood down.

Script.Line: There is a charge down there that did not go off.
I am not going back in until somebody who knows what they are doing says so.
My lads are at the gate and not one of them is going back in.

Lines.Approach: There is a charge that did not go off and the contractor will not go back in.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
